scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @dataprev/api && npm run build --workspace @dataprev/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace @dataprev/api" "npm run dev --workspace @dataprev/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @dataprev/api && npm run lint --workspace @dataprev/web
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
